## Why This Is Asked

Resources:
  BudgetTopic:
    Type: AWS::SNS::Topic
    Properties:
      DisplayName: BudgetAlerts

    Type: AWS::Budgets::Budget
    Properties:
      Budget:
        TimeUnit: MONTHLY
        BudgetType: COST

```

- Rollback criteria tied to data latency and coverage

# adot-config.yaml (high level example)
apiVersion: v1
kind: ConfigMap
metadata:
  name: adot-config
  namespace: default
data:
  otel.yaml: |
    receivers:
      kubernetes: {}
    exporters:
      awsemf: {}
      awstrace: {}
    service:
      pipelines:
        traces:
          receivers: [kubernetes]
          exporters: [awstrace, awsemf]
```
